title: Insecure Unquoted Service Binary Paths Detected
description: Services installed in paths with spaces without enclosing quotation marks are susceptible to binary planting privilege escalation.
expected: All service paths with spaces properly quoted
impact: Local standard users can drop an executable into intermediate directory paths (e.g. C:\Program.exe) to achieve SYSTEM execution.
remediation_guidance: Wrap executable paths in double quotes in registry HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\<ServiceName>\ImagePath.

compliance_mappings.title: Secure Service Binary Permissions and Paths
